raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-PER-ArequipaColca",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "The newly created Project Implementation Unit (PIU) lacks experience with World Bank‑financed projects, risking weak fiduciary and compliance controls.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement intensive capacity‑building on World Bank FM, procurement and ESG procedures; assign senior technical advisors and conduct regular audits.",
      "evidence": "III.A: GORE has experience ... but does not have experience implementing WB‑financed projects, so capacity building will be required."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Delayed recruitment of key financial management and technical staff could postpone project start‑up and disbursements.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Prepare detailed TORs early, launch recruitment within 30 days of effectiveness, and use interim consultants to cover gaps.",
      "evidence": "B. FM risk: Delayed recruitment of FM staff; terms of reference will be prepared and staff appointed within two months."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Budget allocation and execution delays, common in Peru, may slow implementation and affect cash flow.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Begin budget allocation process immediately after loan signing; set internal milestones and monitor execution monthly against the Project Operations Manual.",
      "evidence": "B. FM risk: Budget allocation and execution delays are typical in Peru’s initial project phases."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Inaccurate accounting or financial reporting due to limited experience with Bank‑financed projects could trigger audit findings and repayment issues.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Adopt the national accounting system (SIAF), conduct annual independent audits, and provide staff training on WB reporting standards.",
      "evidence": "B. FM risk: Potential inaccuracies in accounting and financial reporting due to inadequate experience."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Fragmented institutional landscape and weak inter‑agency coordination may cause project delays and cost overruns.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Activate the high‑level Steering and Consultative Committees, formalize Interinstitutional Agreements early, and use a coordination matrix to track responsibilities.",
      "evidence": "B. Sectoral and Institutional Context: lack of coordination within a highly fragmented institutional landscape."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Climate‑related hazards (floods, landslides, earthquakes) could damage upgraded roads and heritage sites, undermining project benefits.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate climate‑resilient design standards (drainage, slope stabilization, seismic retrofitting) and conduct regular hazard monitoring during construction and operation.",
      "evidence": "11: Climate hazards ... floods, landslides, droughts ... affect the tourism sector."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Insufficient road safety features may lead to high accident rates, deterring tourists and increasing fatalities.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement comprehensive safety designs (guardrails, signage, pedestrian crossings) and conduct road safety audits before commissioning.",
      "evidence": "36: Arequipa has a higher road fatality rate; designs will include safety features."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Poor water and sanitation infrastructure could create health hazards for visitors and locals, reducing tourism attractiveness.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Upgrade water supply, sewage and wastewater treatment to meet health standards; establish O&M plans and regular water quality monitoring.",
      "evidence": "10: Poor water and sanitation facilities create a health hazard for communities and tourists."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Sexual exploitation and harassment (SEA/SH) risks may deter women’s participation and generate reputational damage.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Enforce the SEA/SH Action Plan, provide training on gender‑sensitive conduct, and set up a confidential grievance mechanism.",
      "evidence": "21: Project’s action plan on SEA and SH will address barriers to entry."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Existing gender wage and participation gaps could limit women’s benefit from tourism jobs, undermining inclusion goals.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Target capacity‑building for women’s associations, monitor gender employment indicators, and promote women‑owned enterprises through procurement preferences.",
      "evidence": "20: Gender gap in labor force participation; women face wage gaps and barriers."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Insufficient private sector investment may leave the project’s demand generation and sustainability objectives unmet.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop a clear investment pipeline, use the Obras por Impuestos mechanism, and provide investment incentives (tax breaks, PPP models).",
      "evidence": "23: Private sector willing to invest once infrastructure is upgraded; examples of PPP and Obras por Impuestos."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Procurement staff’s limited familiarity with World Bank procurement rules could cause non‑compliance and delays.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide targeted procurement training, use standard WB procurement documents, and conduct pre‑bid reviews by the Bank’s procurement specialists.",
      "evidence": "63: Project procurement will follow World Bank’s Procurement Regulations; GORE’s logistics office responsible."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Disbursement is conditional on signing three Interinstitutional Agreements; delays in these could stall cash flow.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Prioritize negotiation and signing of Interinstitutional Agreements within the first 60 days; monitor progress weekly.",
      "evidence": "Conditions: No withdrawals shall be made ... unless at least three signed Interinstitutional Agreements."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Inadequate data collection and monitoring may prevent accurate assessment of project outcomes and trigger performance penalties.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish the tourism information system early, train PIU staff on data protocols, and conduct periodic data quality audits.",
      "evidence": "22: Stakeholder Engagement Plan includes indicators; data collection will require complementary mechanisms by the PIU."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Tourism demand may fall short of forecasts, reducing economic returns and job creation.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement aggressive marketing (Component 3), diversify tourism products, and monitor demand trends to adjust promotion strategies promptly.",
      "evidence": "53: Sensitivity analysis shows NPV drops with 25% shock to tourism consumption."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Future pandemics or health crises could sharply reduce tourist arrivals, affecting revenue projections.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Develop health‑security protocols for tourism sites, promote domestic tourism, and maintain flexible marketing plans to shift target markets quickly.",
      "evidence": "3: Pandemic severely impacted the sector; 2025 arrivals at 78% of pre‑pandemic levels."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Political instability may disrupt government support, funding flows, or policy continuity.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Secure multi‑year commitments from MINCETUR and MEF, embed project governance in legal agreements, and maintain regular dialogue with political leaders.",
      "evidence": "1: Recent years show increased political instability."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R18",
      "description": "Cost overruns due to fragmented responsibilities and unforeseen technical challenges could exhaust the financing envelope.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement rigorous cost monitoring, contingency budgeting (5% of component costs), and require periodic financial reporting to the Bank.",
      "evidence": "42: Coordination across ministries and sectors is complex; lack of strategic national investment plan."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R19",
      "description": "Community grievances not addressed timely may lead to social opposition and project delays.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Activate the grievance redress mechanism, set a 30‑day response target, and publish quarterly grievance resolution reports.",
      "evidence": "22: Indicator on percentage of project‑related grievances addressed by the PIU."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R20",
      "description": "Insufficient climate‑resilience of water and sanitation infrastructure could lead to service disruptions during extreme events.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Design water and wastewater systems with flood‑resilient components, conduct climate risk assessments, and establish emergency O&M protocols.",
      "evidence": "38: Subcomponent 2.2 promotes resilience against floods by providing sewage systems."
    }
  ]
}

risks.description: The newly created Project Implementation Unit (PIU) lacks experience with World Bank‑financed projects, risking weak fiduciary and compliance controls.
